caption: The drawing features a rectangular, plaid fabric sample centered on a plain, beige background. The fabric is composed of a repeating pattern of light orange and off-white squares, with horizontal and vertical lines forming a grid and intersecting at right angles. The orange squares are made up of a slightly darker and lighter orange thread in a woven texture, and the off-white squares exhibit a similar woven appearance. Below the fabric sample, on the beige background, there are two handwritten words in cursive script: "Westchester County" on the left side and "Dan Teket" on the right side. The overall composition is minimalistic, with the checkered pattern occupying the central portion of the drawing and ample empty space surrounding it.
title: Hand Woven Linen
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
